description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

features.name: Rage
features.tldr: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity, gaining resistance to physical damage and bonus damage on melee attacks.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.tldr: While not wearing any armor, your Armor Class calculates as 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.tldr: Throw aside concern for defense to gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls during your turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.tldr: Gain an uncanny sense of things nearby, giving you advantage on Dexterity saving throws against visible effects.

features.name: Primal Path
features.tldr: Choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage, granting specialized features.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.tldr: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.tldr: Your instincts sharpen, granting advantage on initiative rolls and letting you act normally if surprised by avoiding ambush conditions.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Brutal Critical (1 die)
features.tldr: You can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.tldr: Your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds, dropping to 1 hit point instead of 0 on a successful Constitution save.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Brutal Critical (2 dice)
features.tldr: The extra damage dice for your critical hits increases to two additional dice.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.tldr: Your rage is so fierce that it only ends early if you fall unconscious or choose to end it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Brutal Critical (3 dice)
features.tldr: The extra damage dice for your critical hits increases to three additional dice.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.tldr: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Primal Champion
features.tldr: Embody wild power, increasing your Strength and Constitution scores by 4 and raising their maximum to 24.
